mechanism: Both turmeric (curcumin) and terbinafine are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (primarily CYP3A4 and CYP2D6), with potential for competition and curcumin's known CYP450 inhibition at higher doses.
action: Monitor for terbinafine efficacy and adverse effects; consider spacing doses or reducing turmeric supplementation if high-dose formulations are used; monitor liver function periodically.
